user.title: Smart Shade Awning
user.description:
⚠️ **Unofficial integration for motorised outdoor equipment.** Not affiliated with or supported by any awning manufacturer. Home Assistant cannot see where your awning actually is and cannot detect wind — never rely on this as a safety system, and leave your wind sensor in place. Provided as-is with no warranty; you are responsible for any automation you write and its physical consequences.

Choose **Set up my awning** to connect normally.

Choose **Compatibility report** if setup fails, or if your brand is one of the unconfirmed ones. It signs in, prints what the cloud returned, and saves nothing — no account is added. The report contains no email, password, token, nickname, location or full serial number, so it is safe to paste into a GitHub issue.

login.title: Sign in
login.description:
Pick the app you sign into on your phone. Brands use separate logins, so your details are only ever sent to the one you choose.

**Only Marygrove is confirmed**, on a Spettmann Smart-Shade Mini Hub. The three apps marked *shares a confirmed login* use byte-identical credentials, so signing in should work — but no awning of those brands has ever been driven end to end. Apps marked *untested* have never been run at all. Either way, please tell us how it went at https://github.com/briandoherty/ha-smartshade/issues

data_description.brand: confirmed = driven end to end on real hardware. shares a confirmed login = same credentials as Marygrove, so sign-in should work, but nobody has moved one of these awnings. untested = never run.

report.title: Compatibility report
report.description:
Pick your app and sign in to generate the report. Nothing is saved and no devices are added — this only reads.

The report is also written to the Home Assistant log at warning level, so you can copy it from Settings → System → Logs if the dialog is awkward to select from.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your password
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login for {username} stopped working. Sign in again to reconnect your awning.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password — or the wrong app was selected. Each brand's accounts exist in only one login system, so check the app you actually sign into.
error.cannot_connect: Signed in, but could not fetch your devices. If you picked anything other than Marygrove this is the failure we most need reports of — please open an issue with the report from the log.
error.user_not_found: No account with that email exists in this app's login system. Common causes: the wrong app selected (each brand's accounts live in only one login system), a typo, or an address that isn't your usual one. Capitalisation is retried automatically, so that isn't the cause.

abort.report:
Compatibility report — copy everything below into a GitHub issue at https://github.com/briandoherty/ha-smartshade/issues

```
{report}
```

Nothing was saved. Run setup again to add your awning.

init.title: Remote settings
init.description: These build the RF command sent to your awning: remoteType:action:remoteNumber:channel+receiver. If open/close do nothing, adjust these to match your paired remote.
